title: Bringing the Full Sequence Together
hook: Every part you’ve learned, in order, on one bearish chart.

launchpad.outcome: Walk the full sequence on a bearish chart and name the step each requirement belongs to.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What does each step of the sequence require before the next one counts?

takeaways: BOS #1: a 15M candle close through the 15M level, in the direction of the higher-timeframe story.
Correction #1 and BOS #2 happen on the 5M. You don’t enter on BOS #1 or BOS #2.
Correction #2 creates the zone. BOS #3 activates it.
After BOS #3, wait for price to return to the zone. Don’t chase.

slides.headline: Every step, in one sequence.
slides.line: You’ve learned each part. Now put them together on one bearish chart, from the first break to the retest.

slides.headline: Six steps. In this order.
slides.line: Tap each step. Each one has its own requirement.

steps.label: BOS #1 · 15M
steps.sub: A 15M candle closes through the 15M level, in the direction of the higher-timeframe (HTF) story.

steps.label: Correction #1 · 5M
steps.sub: A 5M pullback, preferably back toward the original 15M break.

steps.label: BOS #2 · 5M
steps.sub: A 5M close through the swing Correction #1 pulled back from.

steps.label: Correction #2 · 5M
steps.sub: The second pullback. It creates the zone.

steps.label: BOS #3 · 5M
steps.sub: A 5M close through the swing Correction #2 pulled back from. It activates the zone.

steps.label: Retest
steps.sub: Price returns to the zone. Don’t chase if it doesn’t.

slides.kicker: Step 2 · The full sequence on a chart
slides.headline: A bearish sequence, start to finish.
slides.line: Press the button to print each part. The higher-timeframe story is bearish, so you’re looking for supply.

steps.caption: BOS #1. A 15M candle closes below the 15M level, in the direction of the higher-timeframe story.
Correction #1. On the 5M, price bounces up, preferably back toward the original 15M break.
BOS #2. A 5M candle closes below the low Correction #1 pulled back from. Still no entry.
Correction #2 creates the zone: its last bullish candle. It’s only a potential supply zone for now.
BOS #3. A 5M close below the low Correction #2 pulled back from. Now the zone is active.
The retest. Price returns to the zone. The working model places a limit at the zone’s low. A bearish candle close out of the zone is the extra-confirmation option.

slides.headline: Each requirement belongs to one step.
slides.line: Tap each requirement to see which step it belongs to.

cards.label: A 15M candle close through the 15M level
The last bullish candle before sellers produce BOS #3
cards.sub: That’s the zone-forming candle, from Correction #2.

cards.label: Price comes back to the active zone

check.prompt: Bearish model. A 5M candle closes below the low Correction #2 pulled back from. Which step is that?

options.label: BOS #2
options.feedback: BOS #2 closes through the low Correction #1 pulled back from. This close comes after Correction #2.

options.label: BOS #3
options.why: Right. A 5M close through the swing Correction #2 pulled back from is BOS #3. It activates the zone.

options.label: The retest
options.feedback: The retest is price returning to the zone after BOS #3. This candle is the break that activates the zone.

slides.headline: Which step creates the zone?
slides.line: One step creates the zone. A different step activates it.

options.label: Correction #1
options.feedback: Correction #1 comes after BOS #1. It doesn’t create the zone.

options.label: Correction #2
options.why: Right. Correction #2 creates the zone, and BOS #3 activates it.

options.label: BOS #3
options.feedback: BOS #3 activates the zone. The zone itself comes from Correction #2.

slides.headline: Now the mirror. Find the retest.
slides.line: A bullish chart this time. BOS #3 has activated the demand zone.
slides.ask: Tap the first candle that comes back to the demand zone.
slides.why: That’s the first return to the active zone after BOS #3. That’s the retest.

after.caption: 3 Breaks. 2 Corrections. 1 Zone. 1 Retest. The full sequence is complete.

slides.quote: Every step earns the next one. Skip one and there’s no trade.

slides.prompt: In your own words, walk through the full bearish sequence and what each step needs.
slides.modelAnswer: The higher-timeframe ICC is bearish, so I look for supply. BOS #1 is a 15M candle close below the 15M level. Correction #1 is a 5M bounce, preferably back toward the 15M break. BOS #2 is a 5M close below the low Correction #1 pulled back from. Correction #2 creates the zone from its last bullish candle. BOS #3 is a 5M close below the low Correction #2 pulled back from, and it activates the zone. Then I wait for price to return to the zone, and I don’t chase if it doesn’t.
